verdict.rationale: Foreloop does support connecting a repository so an agent/PR-reviewer can access it (foreloop-docs-15, foreloop-docs-22), but the documented flow is multi-step rather than one-click: install the CLI globally, run `foreloop init` to add the task-executor skill, connect GitHub, and create/manage separate API keys per integration (foreloop-docs-1, foreloop-docs-2, foreloop-docs-38). This is a real but non-trivial setup, not the frictionless single-click grant the story describes. Missing for 10: an explicit one-click/OAuth-style repo connect flow, and evidence that no CLI/init/key steps are required.
